The verdicts for visible features (geometry, typography, dynamic poses) are accurate. The classification of 'speech bubbles' as present is slightly generous given the lack of clear traditional bubbles, but the presence of caption boxes satisfies the functional requirement for text integration in comics.
artifact_review: The Router's identification of text gibberish is confirmed by the Image Text Auditor, which extracted nonsensical strings ('STTOAM', 'da.', '000') with low-to-moderate confidence. This is a definitive AI artifact. The severity of 2.5 is appropriate; while the text is illegible, it doesn't completely destroy the composition. The Router's note on texture anomalies in hands is supported by the general 'slight compression/blur' noted by the Perceptual Quality Auditor, though the Topology Auditor found high mask confidence, suggesting the limbs are structurally connected even if stylistically soft. The artifact score should reflect the text failure primarily.
alignment_reasoning: The Fine Grained Classifier strongly confirms the class 'comic book' (logit 7.57 vs 3.91 for next best). All testable visual checkpoints (portrait orientation, bold typography, dynamic action art, glossy appearance) are met. The image successfully mimics the aesthetic of a vintage comic cover.
artifact_reasoning: Primary defect is text generation failure. The Image Text Auditor extracted gibberish ('STTOAM'), confirming the Router's observation of illegible title/captions. This is a common generative flaw. Secondary minor artifacts include slight smudging in character extremities and mild compression noise, but no catastrophic structural failures (melting/fusion) were detected by the Topology Auditor.
